title: [Bug]: DocumentBlock not supported for OpenAI models
body:
# Bug Description

It seems like DocumentBlock support wasn't added properly for OpenAI models. Specifically it is not handled in `to_openai_message_dict` method [here](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/b6b0e00046b8944a6cc39d53eaa293530de98a9a/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-openai/llama_index/llms/openai/utils.py#L326).

The DocumentBlock seems to be handled for `to_openai_responses_message_dict` [here](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/b6b0e00046b8944a6cc39d53eaa293530de98a9a/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-openai/llama_index/llms/openai/utils.py#L458).


### Version

0.13.1

### Steps to Reproduce

```python
import os
import tempfile
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from llama_index.llms.openai import OpenAI
from llama_index.core.llms import ChatMessage, DocumentBlock, MessageRole, TextBlock

# Load environment variables from .env file
load_dotenv()

# Create a temporary PDF file
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix='.pdf') as temp_pdf:
    temp_pdf.write(b"%PDF-1.4\n1 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\nendobj\n")
    pdf_path = temp_pdf.name

# Create GPT-5 LLM instance
llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-5-2025-08-07", temperature=0.1)

# Create messages with DocumentBlock 
system_msg = ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.SYSTEM, blocks=[TextBlock(text="Extract information from the document.")])
user_msg = ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.USER, blocks=[DocumentBlock(path=pdf_path, document_mimetype="application/pdf")])

# This should fail with: ValueError: Unsupported content block type: DocumentBlock
try:
    resp = llm.chat(messages=[system_msg, user_msg])
    print("Success:", resp.message.content)
except ValueError as e:
    print("Error:", e)
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
finally:
    os.unlink(pdf_path)
```

# Description
This pull request updates the handling of document blocks in OpenAI message construction and bumps the package version. The main changes improve support for document file uploads and ensure correct MIME type processing.

**Enhancements to OpenAI message construction:**

* Added support for `DocumentBlock` in `to_openai_message_dict`, allowing document files to be included as input files with proper base64 encoding and MIME type detection.
* Ensured MIME type is correctly set for document blocks in `to_openai_responses_message_dict` when decoding base64 data.

**Project version update:**

* Updated the package version in `pyproject.toml` from `0.5.4` to `0.5.5`.

Fixes [#19666](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/issues/19666)
